basic_info.description: Introducing 60 Laidley Street, a prime redevelopment opportunity nestled in the heart of San Francisco over-looking views of Noe Valley perched on the prestigious 100 Block of Laidley. This existing structure is permitted/entitled to rebuild a magnificent 4000 sqft home, presenting an exciting investment prospect for a developer or discerning buyers looking to build their dream home on a prestigious block. The home features vast floor plates with appealing layouts, an ELEVATOR and sweeping unobstructed City Views.
